title: Worker Exit Signal
description: Schema for the exit signal a worker emits at end of invocation. Parsed by run-iteration.sh. Permissive for now; will tighten once autonomous mode (Phase 3) defines the full contract.

exit_code.description: 0 = continue (more work to do), 1 = phase complete (blocked=true), 2 = escalate (worker needs human input or health-check tripped).

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the exit, especially for code 1 and 2.

next_action.description: Action the next invocation should take, when known.
